Wide river-bend shoreline: broad pressed clay river basin in slate and cobalt, thumb-pushed current-ripple marks sweeping the bend's inner curve, a gravel bar of rolled clay pebbles in cream and ochre deposited at the bend, steep cut clay banks in sienna on the outer curve showing scored strata layers, clusters of rolled horsetail-reed rods in olive flanking both banks, smooth clay mud flats finger-pressed flat at the water's edge.

Thundering waterfall basin: tall scored clay cliff face in rust and ochre with a channel gorge cut deep through the center, a rolled clay water-curtain pressed in pale cream tumbling over the lip, white foam-froth texture pinched in cream at the plunge pool base, a deep circular clay pool in cobalt-slate pressed smooth below, wet-clay sheen finger-smoothed onto every surrounding rock face, moss-green clay clumps pressed into every crevice.

Open horsetail-reed meadow: dense forest of rolled clay horsetail stems in olive and sage covering the entire field floor, scored segmented joints pressed at regular intervals up every stem, small pinched clay spore cones tipping the tallest stalks, a soft pressed clay ground in ochre between stem bases, scattered low clay rush tufts in deep green filling the gaps, gentle rolling clay ground swells giving the meadow a breathing rhythm.

Flowering fern-carpet plain: an unbroken pressed clay floor in sage and ochre, finger-rolled clay fern fronds in deep olive unfurling in dense overlapping waves, tiny scored clay flower-heads in rust and cream dotting the tips of low plants, scattered rounded clay boulders in slate half-buried in frond mass, a low clay ridge horizon in sienna banding the far edge, ground-hugging clay moss in pale green pressed between every fern base.

Jagged mountain-ridge crest: sharp clay peaks in slate-grey and charcoal pinched to knife edges at the crest line, scored vertical fracture planes splitting every face, tumbled clay boulder fields in ochre and rust pressing against every base, thin clay scree tongues spilling down every chute, a scored distant ridge chain in pale grey receding to the horizon, wind-hollowed clay alcoves scooped beneath overhanging ridge teeth.

Rocky dragon-back escarpment: a long sinuous clay ridge in rust and ochre with a serrated crest of pinched clay teeth, scored layered strata lines running horizontally along the full flank, loose clay rubble aprons rolled and pressed at the foot of every tooth, deep shadow gorges tool-carved between the ridge fins, scattered sage-clay shrub clumps pinched into ledge cracks, an open pressed clay plateau stretching flat behind the spine.

Phosphorescent moss-flat hollow: a sunken pressed clay basin carpeted in textured clay moss in cobalt and pale green, soft stippled surface across the entire moss mat suggesting bioluminescent glow, finger-smoothed rounded clay stones in cream half-buried in the moss, low scored clay log forms in sienna decomposing across the floor, pale rolled clay spore-tendril wisps rising from the moss surface, deep shadow walls of scored dark clay pressing close on every side.

Rocky coral-clay tide-pool shore: a jagged pressed clay reef shelf in ochre and rust jutting into a cobalt clay sea, deep tool-carved tide-pool basins filled with smooth pressed blue-green clay water, pinched clay anemone clusters in cream and rust rimming every pool edge, scored barnacle-crust texture blanketing every exposed rock face, scattered rounded clay cobbles in slate and sienna covering the foreshore, low scored sea-cliff faces rising steeply at the land edge.
